class.name: NoodleNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for all Noodle Nodes AI and query nodes.
class.description: Common base node for Noodle Nodes utility AI, behaviour trees, state trees, HTN planners, and the Node Query System. Provides shared [member is_enabled] toggling and convenience helpers ([method get_blackboard], [method set_blackboard], [method get_actor]) that automatically resolve the [NNBlackboard] and actor from the nearest ancestor root ([NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], or [NNHTNRoot]), allowing nested AI systems to share context without extra wiring.

method.name: erase_blackboard
method.description: Removes [param key] from the owning root's blackboard. Returns [code]false[/code] if the key does not exist or there is no root ancestor.

method.name: get_actor
method.description: Returns the actor [Node] associated with the nearest ancestor root, or [code]null[/code] if none is found.

method.name: get_blackboard
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key] in the owning root's blackboard, or [param default_value] if the key is missing or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_blackboard_resource
method.description: Returns the active [NNBlackboard] resolved through the nearest ancestor root, or [code]null[/code] if there is no root ancestor.

method.name: get_debug_snapshot
method.description: Returns a debugger snapshot of this node if it is a root ([NNAgent], [NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], or [NNHTNRoot]), or an empty [Dictionary] otherwise. Only available in debug builds.

method.name: has_blackboard
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] exists in the owning root's blackboard with a non-[code]null[/code] value.

method.name: set_blackboard
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] in the owning root's blackboard. Returns [code]false[/code] if the key is empty, rejected by the schema, or there is no root ancestor.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], this node is skipped by its parent when evaluating, ticking, planning, or running children. Disabling a root stops it from ticking.
